context: Scene A2 was redesigned after user rejection: previous version cropped the separated vertical and the ghost/fill correspondence was unreadable. Current version renders the ghost as contour line-art (FUDE outline base via strokeContours/ContourField) registered to the bunkai strokes by a measured similarity transform, shows only the crossing-cluster runs4 strokes (014/015/016/017) as filled ink, separates the vertical stroke fully inside frame, adds crossing-point markers and a hidden-part contour at the original crossing position. Judge the fixed criteria on these frames.
